summary: Apollomics Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its interim financial information for the period ended June 30, 2026, an ordinary periodic report by a foreign private issuer (the non-US analogue of a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q). The XBRL-tagged exhibits reference routine items: share-based compensation plans, a convertible note, warrant fair-value measurements tied to the legacy Maxpro Capital Acquisition Corp. SPAC, subscription agreements, and a CFO subsequent-event tag. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock is disclosed. No special-situation event is present; watch only ordinary financing and going-concern disclosures.
